English: Street Vendor Row
A ragged line of makeshift stalls and tents, offering basic goods to travelers and settlers.
Market Courtyard
A central open yard surrounded by sturdier wooden stalls, drawing greater crowds and commerce.
Covered Alley
Wooden awnings and a simple roof offer protection from sun and rain, attracting more merchants.
Spice Hall
A dedicated, roofed market for rare and valuable spices, attracting traders from afar.
Artisans Passage
A bustling row of workshops for skilled craftspeople, protected by stone archways.
Goldsmiths Lane
A secure, walled street for the citys goldsmiths and jewelers, tightly guarded and bustling with trade.
Silk Bazar
An ornate hall for the silk trade, with vaulted ceilings and skilled guards, serving merchants from distant lands.
Textile Row
A broad avenue lined with textile merchants and weavers, protected by city guards and open to caravans.
Souk Pavilion
A grand market pavilion of stone and mosaic, its shaded arcades thronging with merchants and officials.
Grand Souk
A legendary center of commerce, with fortified gates, marble halls, and a labyrinth of shops, attracting traders from across the world.
